messages:
maria: Quick sync — need a final gating checklist for enterprise compliance launch (audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 evidence, retention). Short proposal below.

ankur: quick Q — scope for providers? AWS + Azure only or include GCP?

sasha: MVP = AWS + Azure KMS. GCP post-MVP.

maria: OK. Proposed Gate A (pre-launch): 1) Search SLO for hot window (60d) documented + benchmarks, 2) Per-tenant TTL UI + API, 3) BYOK handshake + integration tests (AWS/Azure), 4) SOC2 evidence packaging (manifest + SHA256 + detached signature), 5) Legal retention matrix + hold process.

devon: ops: add requirement for key-escrow & emergency-export runbook (approval flow + terraform worker). Oncall will block without it.

kate (legal): Need retention justification per tier and legal-hold override that prevents deletion. Also require evidence metadata schema (actor, action, timestamp, request_id).

ankur: infra note — SLO scoped to hot window only. Cold data via async export (24h SLA). Will post perf numbers.

sasha: I'll add SDK handshake samples and integration test matrix.

maria: Ops-bot — schedule canary if we lock scope?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary tentative window scheduled: 2026-06-10T00:00Z -> 2026-06-13T00:00Z. Alerts set.

maria: Action items: @ankur perf bench, @sasha SDK + tests, @devon escrow runbook draft, @kate upload retention matrix + schema. If ACKs + artifacts by EOD we lock Gate A.

ankur: ACK, posting perf by EOD (3967001200).

sasha: ACK, PR incoming (3967001250).

devon: Drafting runbook now (3967001280).

kate (legal): ACK, uploading docs (3967001300).

maria: Thanks — will mark gate set in roadmap once artifacts are in. :rocket:
